name: [⚔️1v1] Clean the Supermarket!
desc:
👍LIKE + JOIN GROUP👍

PC Controls:
E - Interact
F - Drop
T - Wipe Save
Click - Place

Console Controls:
RT - Interact
B/O - Drop
RT - Place
D-Pad - Abilities

The supermarket is in complete chaos and you need to sort and organize the hundreds of items back onto their shelves!

Sort, organize, and restore 1000+ Supermarket items to restore order. It sounds easy... until the shelves start stretching farther than they should.

🍎 Sort thousands of food items
✨ Buy upgrades and become the ultimate stocker
🏆 Stock the shelves and restore order
